race.comment: NEVER KNOW (6) has made good improvement this time in and finds a winnable race with the blinkers going on. Will appreciate the step up in trip on the home track after finishing second over 1200m at Wyong. Will push forward again and prove hard to stop. SEMINAL (10) three-year-old Street Boss filly from Fee Dansante on debut for the O'Shea & Charlton stable. Finished a solid third in a Rosehill trial over 900m on August 21. Lugging bit goes on and must be kept safe. CALL ME COACH (5) three-year-old Dundeel colt from Mother's Mercy on debut for the Anthony & Sam Freedman stable. Has trialled on four occasions leading into today's race and must be kept safe. TAHURANGI (12) has disappointed in two runs back on the provincial circuit and strips fitter with the weight drop. Another likely to go forward and run a much better race.
